Guidance for Claude Code (claude.ai/code). Native SwiftUI iOS Hotlympics app; Firebase Auth/Storage and Google Sign-In via Swift Package Manager. Bundle ID: hotlympics.ios-app. Preferred Simulator: iPhone 16 Pro.

open ios-app.xcodeproj
xcodebuild -project ios-app.xcodeproj -scheme ios-app -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16 Pro' build
xcodebuild test -project ios-app.xcodeproj -scheme ios-app -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16 Pro'
xcodebuild clean -project ios-app.xcodeproj

After making changes, build the project and fix any warnings or errors. Test on iPhone 16 Pro simulator.

Main entry: `App/ios_appApp.swift` (Firebase, Google URL schemes). Five tabs: Rating and Leaderboard (unrestricted); Upload, My Photos, Profile (authentication and complete profile required). `auth/FirebaseAuthService`: Firebase/Google OAuth, tokens/session restoration, backend profile sync, gender/DOB and ToS updates, current-user completion status. `data/ImageQueueService`: active/buffer blocks (10 each), prefetching, opposite-gender filtering, auth reset. `api/RatingService`: ratings. `data/ImagePreloader`: NSCache, 50-image limit, shared, memory-pressure clearing. `api/UploadService`: signed URL, compression, Firebase Storage upload, progress, confirmation. `data/UserService`: five-minute cache, preloading, refresh after changes, optimistic deletion, pool cleanup. Rating/, Upload/, Photos/, Auth/, shared/ contain swipe rating, 400x400 crop/upload, photo grid (max 2 pool photos), sign-in/profile setup, and cached image components. ViewModels manage state, validation, optimistic rollback, progress, retries.
